Run an AnyMoE model with a pretrained gating layer instead of training one.

```python
"""Run an AnyMoE model with a pretrained gating layer instead of training one."""

import inference_rs as ir
from inference_rs import types as t

spec = t.EngineSpec(
    model=t.ModelSelectedPlain(
        model_id="mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1",
        arch=t.NormalLoaderType.MISTRAL,
    ),
    anymoe=t.AnyMoeSpec(
        config=t.AnyMoeConfig(
            hidden_size=4096,
            expert_type="fine_tuned",
            lr=1e-3,
            epochs=100,
            batch_size=4,
            gate_model_id="path/to/pretrained/gating_model_id",
            training=False,
            loss_csv_path="loss.csv",
        ),
        path="examples/amoe.json",
        prefix="model.layers",
        mlp="mlp",
        model_ids=["HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-beta"],
        layers=list(range(16)),
    ),
)

with ir.Engine(spec) as engine:
    res = engine.chat(
        t.ChatCompletionRequest(
            model="default",
            messages=[
                t.Message(
                    role="user", content="Tell me a story about the Rust type system."
                )
            ],
            max_tokens=256,
            presence_penalty=1.0,
            top_p=0.1,
            temperature=0.1,
        )
    )
    print(res.choices[0].message.content)
    print(res.usage)
```
